question: Where is the 78th session of the World Health Organisation (WHO) Regional Committee for South-East Asia being held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Colombo.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The 78th session of the World Health Organisation (WHO) Regional Committee for South-East Asia is being held in Colombo.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The session brings together health leaders and experts to discuss key **public health priorities** in the region.
 
• India’s Minister of State for Health, **Anupriya Patel**, will attend the plenary session, showcasing India’s commitment to advancing **regional health cooperation**.
 
• WHO Director-General **Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus** and WHO’s Regional Director for South-East Asia, **Dr. Catharina Boehme**, will also be in attendance.
 
• Discussions will focus on promoting **healthy ageing, curbing tobacco consumption, expanding the Regional Health Emergency Fund**, and tackling **antimicrobial resistance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **WHO Regional Committee for South-East Asia**__: A key meeting of health leaders to discuss priorities and strategies for public health in the region.
 
• __**Regional Health Emergency Fund**__: A fund aimed at providing financial resources for emergency health responses in the South-East Asia region.
 
• __**Antimicrobial resistance (AMR)**__: The ability of microorganisms to resist the effects of drugs that once killed them, posing a major challenge to global health.
 
• __**Healthy ageing**__: Promoting better health outcomes for the elderly through improved primary healthcare systems and preventative measures.
